laws.rule: Central Balkan National Park: open fires banned; no entering lakes or rivers; stay on marked routes; no flower picking; camping only at marked sites near huts; fishing entirely banned; dogs on a lead. Breaches are fined 500 to 5,000 leva for individuals (as published by the ministry; not converted).
